notes.content:

[h1]Removed:[/h1] Anubis from Afterlife Maze. Reason,[i] (To difficult)[/i]

notes.title: Golden Moon Update v1.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes: [/b][i](Thanks Egyptian-Enthusiast!)[/i]
[list]
[*] Added chase timer reset after 8 seconds for A.I. getting stuck in a positive chase loop-
[*] Removed Elevator damage bug- (Caused by crush plane underneath elevator being lifted by the doors)
[/list]

[b]Overworld:[/b]
[list]
[*] General Lighting Improvements-
[*] Added Smoke to generators and improved campsite dialogue timing-
[/list]

[b]Underworld:[/b]
[list]
[*] General Lighting Improvements-
[*] Removed "invisawalls" previously forcing players to take the side-pathways-
[/list]

[b]Underworld C2[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Walkway camera collision issue previously causing the player to effectively be "tunneled" 
[/list]

[b]Underworld FC[/b]
[list]
[*] General Lighting Improvements-
[*] Reduced damage taken from final pit-
[/list]

[b]Afterlife[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some sound issues caused by A.I. Anubis setting off traps like the goofball it is-
[*] General Lighting Improvements-
[/list]

[b]Afterlife C2[/b]
[list]
[*] General Lighting Improvements-
[*] Added Correct or Incorrect notifs for quiz section-
[/list]

[b]Ancient Library:[/b]
[list]

[*] General Lighting Improvements-

[/list]

notes.title: Golden Moon Update v1.1
notes.content:
[h1]A.I. Improvement[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed Animatronic Anubis in every level to teleport the player upon contact to a designated location earlier in the level and subtract only -25 health.
[/list]

[h1][b]Overworld:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] General Lighting Improvements-
[*] Added Dialogue to the Nurse, and Campsite Manager-
[*] Made Keys "More Visible"-
[/list]

[h1]Underworld C2[/h1]
[list]
[*] General Lighting Improvements-
[*] Added door switch to inside of mummification room-
[*] Upper level key location hitbox has been extended
[*] Added 1 new key location
[/list]

[h1]Underworld FC[/h1]
[list]
[*] A.I. Positional Adjustment
[/list]

[h1]Afterlife C2[/h1]
[list]
[*] Floor spikes Adjustment to -25hp/ teleport the player to the start of the tunnel entrance-
[/list]

[h1]Credits[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Scott Tucker to "Proofreading" [i](Thanks!)[/i]
[/list]
